title: Maali Singh Demands the Richest Chest

blocks.text: Maali Singh asks not for scattered goods but for the single object that holds the finest value, pressing Dileram to name the choicest possession in the house. The answer points to a guarded steel chest taken from beneath the stairs and hidden in a protected room rather than among ordinary loot.

Dileram identifies it as the repository of Begum Noor Jahan's jewels, a cache whose prestige matters as much as its price. The page lingers over the distinction between common plunder and courtly treasure, making clear why this particular discovery inflames ambition beyond the earlier division of spoils.

From this point onward, the struggle is no longer only about who conquered Dileram. It is about who will secretly control the most illustrious part of his wealth before allies can insist on their lawful share.
